envelope.description: Terminal tracker setup through the daemon with a validated plan

body.title: Terminal tracker setup through the daemon with a validated plan
body.summary: Add planTrackerConfig (strict readRepoEntry first; any structural failure is a failed plan; then the existing completeness test), the optional configOutcome seam on runTrackerSetup, and make trackerSetup in src/cli/services/workflow.ts asynchronous: plan, call repo.trackerConfig.ensure through rpc with timeoutMs 15000 when a write is needed, then run the remaining steps. Update the command layer, the TUI and Services callers. The deadline bounds only the config call; the other steps run afterwards and are not bounded by it.
acceptanceChecks: planTrackerConfig returns failed with the strict message, calls no daemon and writes nothing for a null own entry with a complete default, a null default, non-object levels and invalid JSON, without throwing

With a running test daemon the config step reports done or already with today's detail text; with no daemon, a silent daemon and an early-closing daemon it reports failed within the deadline and says the daemon owns the file
In every failure branch the remaining setup steps still execute and report, asserted separately from the timeout assertion; no test claims a 15 second total setup time
makeServices always passes configOutcome into runTrackerSetup and a source search test fails if production code outside the daemon and tests calls it without it
Existing runTrackerSetup tests pass unchanged without the seam
